licensingNotice: The measured source is a real, live company's marketing site. This repo carries geometry, tokens, structure and timing only. Never reproduce the source company's logo or wordmark, product screenshots, extension/app icons, illustrations, marketing copy, real prices, or any real person's photo, name, handle or quote. All copy must be original and all visuals must be original CSS/SVG placeholders.
forbiddenContent: source-company product screenshots or UI replicas
source-company marketing copy (headlines, taglines, FAQ text)
source-company plan names or real prices
real people's photos, names, handles or quotes
real third-party logos or app-store badges

generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Use the repo's own neutral asset exactly as implemented. Never substitute a different mark.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-component: Render through the named component. Do not generate a new visual for this slot.
generationPolicies.may-generate-new: Generate a new ORIGINAL abstract or simplified visual (CSS/SVG) at the measured geometry. Never trace, recreate or approximate the source company's screenshots, illustrations or product UI.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate-real: Only invented, clearly fictional people. Never a real person's name, photo, likeness, handle or quote, and never the source company's real customers or staff.
generationPolicies.must-not-use-real-mark: Only neutral invented wordmarks/badges. Never a real company's logo, wordmark or app-store badge artwork.
generationPolicies.must-be-nonfunctional: Decorative pattern only. Must not encode a real URL or be scannable to any destination.

brand.wordmark.description: The neutral 'Launchpad' wordmark plus the original gradient LogoMark. This replaces the source company's logo everywhere.

icon.glyph.description: One of the original 16px line glyphs in shared.jsx Icon (closed name list).

visual.app-tile.description: Generic gradient square standing in for an app or plugin icon (AppTile hue gradient).

visual.gradient-art.description: Abstract blurred gradient art (hero fallback bars, frame wallpaper, footer cube, community and page-hero glows).

visual.webgl-scene.description: The homepage hero's WebGL glass-bars scene (HeroCanvas) with its CSS fallback.

visual.ui-mock.description: Simplified original UI mock (launcher window, chat window, app window) drawn with CSS boxes.

visual.isometric-figure.description: Original isometric line-art SVG on the dotted developer-grid cells.

visual.keyboard.description: Keyboard keys rendered with the Key primitive (.key CSS).

visual.video-placeholder.description: Gradient layer standing in for a video or video thumbnail. No real video files exist in the clone.

person.avatar-placeholder.description: Gradient circle with initials for a fictional person (testimonials, quote chips, store authors).

brand.customer-logo-slot.description: Neutral invented text wordmark in a customer-logo slot.

brand.store-badge-placeholder.description: Invented 'App Shelf' store badge (132x36) in place of a real app-store badge.

visual.qr-placeholder.description: Deterministic pseudo-random module grid that is not a real QR code.
